title: Energy and Vertex Energy of Modified Divisor Prime Graphs
summary: This paper investigates the energy and vertex energy of the modified divisor prime graph $G^*_{Dp}(n)$, which is distinguished from the standard divisor prime graph by the inclusion of a self-loop at the vertex $1$. To facilitate this analysis, we introduce a generalized definition of vertex energy for graphs with self-loops and demonstrate its mathematical consistency.
